disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee is on repeated occasions negligent or incompetent in the practice of dietetics-nutrition.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee is on repeated occasions negligent or incompetent in the practice of professional nursing or dietetics-nutrition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee is unable to practice dietetics-nutrition with reasonable skill and safety due to mental or physical illness or substance dependence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee is unable to practice dietetics-nutrition with reasonable skill and safety to individuals or groups by reason of mental or physical illness or condition or physiological or psychological dependence upon alcohol, hallucinogenic or narcotic drugs or other drugs which tend to impair judgment or coordination

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has willfully or repeatedly violated any provisions of this act or the Board's regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has wilfully or repeatedly violated any of the provisions of this act or of the regulations of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has committed fraud or deceit in the practice of dietetics-nutrition or in securing a license as a dietitian-nutritionist.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the practice of dietetics-nutrition or in securing his or her license as a dietitian-nutritionist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has been convicted of a felony or crime of moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been convicted, or has pleaded guilty, or entered a plea of nolo contendere, or has been found guilty by a judge or jury, of a felony or a crime of moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has had their license suspended, revoked, or received other disciplinary action in another jurisdiction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has his or her license suspended or revoked or has received other disciplinary action by the proper licensing authority in another state, territory, possession or country.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has acted in a manner presenting an immediate and clear danger to public health or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has acted in such a manner as to present an immediate and clear danger to the public health or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee possessed, used, acquired, or distributed a controlled substance or caution legend drug for other than an acceptable medical purpose.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee possessed, used, acquired or distributed a controlled substance or caution legend drug for other than an acceptable medical purpose.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee has been guilty of immoral or unprofessional conduct, including departure from ethical or quality standards of the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee has been guilty of immoral or unprofessional conduct. Unprofessional conduct shall include departure from or failing to conform to an ethical or quality standard of the profession.

definition_quote.value: The 'Practice of dietetics-nutrition' means the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of food nutrition, biochemistry, physiology, management and behavior to provide for all aspects of nutrition therapy for individuals and groups, including nutrition therapy services and medical nutrition therapy, compatible with dietitian-nutritionist education and professional competence.
definition_quote.quote: The "Practice of dietetics-nutrition" means the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of food nutrition, biochemistry, physiology, management and behavior to provide for all aspects of nutrition therapy for individuals and groups, including nutrition therapy services and medical nutrition therapy, compatible with dietitian-nutritionist education and professional competence.

methods_authorized.quote: "Nutrition therapy services" means assessing the nutritional needs of individuals and groups, considering the resources and constraints in the practice setting, providing nutrition counseling in health and disease, developing, implementing and managing: (i) nutrition therapy of; and (ii) food service systems for individuals and groups

This person shall be licensed without the necessity of taking the examination if an application is made to the Board within one (1) year of the effective date of this subsection and the appropriate fee is paid.

medical_nutrition_therapy_authorized.quote: The "Practice of dietetics-nutrition" means the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of food nutrition, biochemistry, physiology, management and behavior to provide for all aspects of nutrition therapy for individuals and groups, including nutrition therapy services and medical nutrition therapy

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: "Medical nutrition therapy" means the component of nutrition therapy that concerns determining and recommending nutrient needs based on nutritional assessment and medical problems relative to diets prescribed by a licensed physician, including: (i) tube feedings; (ii) specialized intravenous solutions; (iii) specialized oral solutions

physician_referral_required.quote: Nothing herein shall preclude an insurer or other third-party payor from requiring that a licensed dietitian-nutritionist obtain a referral from a licensed physician, dentist or podiatrist
